title: Senior Product Manager (DataFetch)
jd_excerpt:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning 
 Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.
In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. 
 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our DataFetch Team. 
What the team does
 DataFetch owns the engine behind every view in Pigment: how users access, explore and display their data. Our mission is to give end users fast, easy access to their data in whatever way suits them, and to give modelers the tools to build views that are robust and performant. We take block data (metrics, lists, tables) and turn it into what a view actually shows: preparing the query (pivot, scope, filters, aggregations), applying access rights, and shaping results ready to render.
 Why it matters
 Views and boards are how most people consume Pigment. Every grid opened, every export run and every drilldown goes through DataFetch, so our work shapes the daily experience of both end users and modelers. And increasingly, agents and AI features rely on us as the data-access layer to retrieve customer data.
 What you'll do 
 - Pitch our product to existing and new customers and collect their feedback through workshops, design sessions, UX research and discovery, together with other PMs and Designers 
 - Build the product vision and roadmap in close collaboration with Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing and Sales; secure the flows of communication between those teams so that everyone has the necessary support and information for customer communication and day to day prioritization 
 - Proactively monitor the market and the competition offer, develop, document and share a solid understanding that fuels our product vision, strategy and choices 
 - You will own your product area end-to-end: from defining the vision and strategy, to leading discovery, prioritization, and delivery with your engineering and design partners. 
 - Participate to continuous improvements of the quality of the product and our delivery processes, help stakeholder teams grow and scale with maximum efficiency 
 Scope & Ownership 
 - Own a product domain 
 - Define and drive the product strategy for your area 
 - Lead product discovery and shape high-impact bets 
 - Be accountable for user value 
 What success looks like after 12 months 
 - Clear product strategy defined for your domain 
 - High-impact features shipped with measurable adoption 
 - Strong collaboration within your team 
 - Recognized as a thought leader in your squad 
 Who you are 
 Experienced: You have prior experience as a Product Manager in SaaS B2B or Finance. 
 Customer-Driven: Passionate about delivering value, you always keep the customer’s needs at the forefront. 
 Cross-Functional Expertise: Your background includes close collaboration with product management, product marketing, sales engineering, and project management. You’re eager to champion and cultivate this collaborative culture. 
 Analytical & Data-Savvy: Strong analytical skills are second nature to you, and you're comfortable with data modeling to inform decision-making. 
 Team-Oriented: A natural team player, you excel at aligning diverse stakeholders towards common goals. 
 Proactive & Self-Driven: You’re curious, autonomous, and highly organized, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. 
 Technical Acumen: With the technical knowledge needed to effectively engage with engineers, you bridge the gap between product and development. 
 Exceptional Communicator: You possess flawless communication skills, both in writing and speaking, ensuring clarity and alignment across the board. 
 What we offer 
 - Competitive package 
 - Equity 
 - Healthcare: Alan Blue for you and your family 
 - Brand new offices in the heart of Paris 
 - Remote-friendly policy 
 #LI-GP1
#LI-HYBRID
